name: Paragraphs usage
description: Check if an a paragraph is used in specific content types.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Synopsis 
 The purpose of this module is to be able to identify which content type can contain which paragraph type.

 When you have a lot of paragraph types, it can be overwhelming identifying which paragraph types can be used in your pages, articles, vocabularies... This modules aims to provide a tool for site builders for showing which content types can contain which paragraph types. 

 Back to top 

 How to use 
 
 Enable the Paragraphs Usage module on your site. 
 Go to /admin/structure/paragraphs_type/{paragraphs_type} 
 Click on Usage tab 
 
 if you have admin_toolbar , you have a new "Usage"' menu entry
